title: Human Eye - Vision Defects and Correction
body:
Study the diagrams showing two common eye defects:

```
[MYOPIA (Short-sightedness)]

    Distant object          EYE (elongated)
         *                 __________
          \               /          \
           \             |   Lens     |
            \===========X|            |----Retina
           /             |   Image    |
          /               \__forms___/
         *                   BEFORE
                             retina

    Problem: Eyeball too LONG or lens too CURVED
    Image forms IN FRONT of retina


[HYPEROPIA (Long-sightedness)]

    Near object            EYE (shortened)
         *                 __________
          \               /          \
           \             |   Lens     |
            \============|======X     |----Retina
           /             |       Image|
          /               \__would___/
         *                   form
                             BEHIND
                             retina

    Problem: Eyeball too SHORT or lens too FLAT
    Image would form BEHIND retina
```

A learner cannot see the chalkboard clearly from the back of the classroom but can read a book easily. Diagnose the condition and state what type of lens would correct it.
